overlayEntry.notes: Reviewed 2026-07-27 (full re-measurement of the 2026-07-20 entry). The white paper documents fUSD minted against ZANO locked in a single publicly auditable staked reserve wallet, with the peg defended by decentralized market-maker bots placing standing buy/sell orders near $1 on the Zano DEX and no oracle or liquidation engine; a fresh read of the white paper and homepage found still no emergency-recovery, shutdown, or holder loss-recovery waterfall disclosure, so those components remain uncurated (bounded-unknown), not graded. The issuer homepage (fetched 2026-07-27T22:54Z; panel self-reports Last updated 7/27/2026 10:50:04 PM) publishes the reserve panel: 11.4M fUSD minted, 7.4M circulating, reserves of $11,115,334.03 (1,254,693.99 ZANO at $8.859) plus $4,000,001 fUSD held in the reserve itself, and a displayed 1.50x coverage ratio. I independently re-verified fUSD current_supply = 114,000,000,000 base units (11,400,000 fUSD, decimal_point 4) via get_asset_info on node.zano.org at Zano height 3790223 (getinfo bracket 2026-07-27T22:56:51Z), matching the homepage minted figure exactly; the asset owner key 497d6b7acd06401c59b2d52a3967968e8ca507a25f80e44d2bb4b5f8a348c7c1 remains the sole EMIT authority per the prior verified mint-authority review. exogenousBackingShare 0.735368 and reflexiveBackingShare 0.264632 are computed from the issuer-published reserve composition ($11,115,334.03 ZANO versus $4,000,001 reserve-held fUSD out of $15,115,335.03 total): just over one quarter of the stated reserve is the token itself. contractionCapacityRatio 1.502072 is the exogenous ZANO reserve value over externally circulating fUSD (11,400,000 minted minus 4,000,001 reserve-held = 7,399,999), matching the issuer's displayed 1.50x. Since 2026-07-20 the ZANO price input fell ($9.481 to $8.859) while the ZANO reserve count rose slightly (1,253,985.99 to 1,254,693.99), lowering coverage from 1.61x to 1.50x and the exogenous share from 0.748258 to 0.735368. All three metric inputs remain issuer-published figures, not independently measured balances: the ZANO reserve balance is NOT publicly queryable on-chain (Zano hides amounts), and while the project publishes a view-only tracking seed for the reserve wallet, re-measuring it requires running Zano wallet software, which this review did not do. The white paper's overcollateralization framing is an off-chain operating policy: Zano consensus validates only the single asset-owner key (verified), never the reserve, and no on-chain contract enforces collateralization. Grades unchanged: contractionCapacity limited (issuer-published panel corroborated by an independent daemon supply read and a published tracking seed, but the reserve balance itself is not third-party-verifiable), confidenceAndIncentives limited (documented open-source market-maker bot incentive design, issuer-published only), oracleAndControlAssumptions limited (no oracle or liquidation engine by design, single verified owner key). NOT established: any emergency recovery, shutdown, or loss-recovery procedure (no such documentation exists in the reviewed sources).
